test_case.test_name: Front USB3 slot1 12-hour stress at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify the mapped front USB3 slot1 sustains the approved integrity load at cold/low-rail margin without speed fallback, data mismatch, reset or platform error.
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions, prove the mapped device is at SuperSpeed, run the pinned SST USB3 integrity profile for 12 hours with continuous link/error telemetry, then warm dry and restore nominal rails.
test_case.expected_result: The exact path completes 12 hours at required USB3 speed with no data mismatch or disallowed reset/controller/kernel/SEL event and healthy restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact slot1 identity, full duration and continuous SuperSpeed/integrity proof; USB2 fallback, another port or a clean final log cannot pass.
safety_gate: Calibrated low-rail ramp and undershoot limit
Abort on condensation, reset storm, mismatch, electrical or thermal fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry warm-up
test_case.recovery: Stop on a limit, preserve evidence, restore nominal rails, warm/dry before access, restore the qualified USB path and do not retry automatically.
